name: Cure Serious Wounds, Mass
body:
Source PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 263
School conjuration (healing); Level cleric 7, druid 8, oracle 7, shaman 7, witch 8
Casting
Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S
Effect
Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will half (harmless) or Will half; see text; Spell Resistance yes (harmless) or yes; see text
Description
This spell functions like mass cure light wounds, except that it cures 3d8 points of damage + 1 point per caster level (maximum +35).
